hero.title: About Us
hero.subtitle: Know more about Gopal Krushna Driving Training School, our journey, values and commitment to safe driving.
hero.imageAlt: Gopal Krushna Driving Training School building among trees

paragraphs: Established in 1993, Gopal Krushna Driving Training School has been a trusted name in Baleswar (Baleshwar) for quality driving training. For over 30 years, we have helped over 1000 learners become confident, skilled and responsible drivers.
We focus on practical, real-road training, road safety awareness and personalized guidance for every learner.
story.imageAlt: School building with a white WagonR and a blue Maruti 800 parked in front

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To provide safe, practical and high-quality driving training that builds confident and responsible drivers.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To be the most trusted driving training school in the region, known for quality training, safety and learner success.

values.title: Safety First
values.text: We prioritize road safety in every step of training.

values.title: Personal Attention
values.text: Individual support for a better learning experience.

values.title: Quality Training
values.text: A perfect blend of practical skills and road awareness.
